description: This file defines the UserPermission controller in the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations for user groups' permissions, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting user groups and their permissions.

classes.name: UserPermission
classes.description: Controller class managing user group permissions in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main user permission page with navigation and list include.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of user groups for display.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches user groups, handles pagination, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a user group, including permissions and routes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated user group data via POST, including permission validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected user groups after permission and user count checks.
